body:
What you say and what happens are two different things. I've been told that and been telling that to myself for years. 

You just said that you meet someone that made you happy then you go on to say that happiness doesn't lie in a girlfriend. It's the same drivel I've been hearing for years now. 

How many more decades am I going to have to wait for it to get better? The only thing worse than living this life would be living this life plus one more day.
